description: A guide to the game, with original NETRICSA artwork and maps.

entries.title: About this guide
entries.summary: Stuck on an enemy or wondering what a weapon does? Start here.

sections.title: Finding something
sections.text: Search for a name or choose a category. Each level links to its 3D view. Weapon and enemy pages also show where you can find them.

sections.title: About this guide
sections.text: The illustrations come from the original game. We wrote these descriptions to help you play. Open Sources & notes if you want to see the research behind an entry.

entries.title: Chainsaw
entries.summary: Samâ€™s close-range weapon. Keep cutting without using any ammo.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: A forestry tool put to a very different use. Youâ€™ll need to get close to make it count.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Get close and hold fire. The PC port gives the chainsaw twice its original reach.

entries.coverage: You start with the chainsaw, so it has no pickup locations. Its longer reach is a PC addition.

entries.title: Double Barrel Coach Gun
entries.summary: A powerful close-range shotgun with a pause between blasts.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Best used up close. Give yourself room to move while you wait for the next blast.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Fires both shells when youâ€™ve got them, or a single shot when only one remains. The Enhanced weapons option changes its spread.

entries.title: Mini Gun
entries.summary: A fast-firing gun that gets through enemiesâ€”and your ammoâ€”quickly.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Youâ€™ll find one early in the Pyramid Entrance Maze. Keep an eye on your ammo.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Hold fire for a steady stream of bullets. The barrels wind down when you stop.

entries.title: Rocket Launcher
entries.summary: Fires rockets that hurt enemies near the blast as well as the target.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: The rocket hurts what it hits, and the explosion catches nearby enemies too.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Aim with the mouse, including up and down. Once fired, a rocket keeps going in that direction.

entries.title: Rogue Prion Gun
entries.summary: Makes affected enemies attack nearby targets while their health drains away.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: This weapon breaks Mentalâ€™s hold over his troops. It also slowly drains their health.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Affected enemies move and act twice as fast in the PC port. They can turn on other enemies, but Sam can still become their target.

entries.title: SBC Cannon
entries.summary: Fires a cannonball that can bounce off walls and plough through enemies.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: A bouncing cannonball can tear through a whole group. Watch where it goes.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: A cannonball can hit several enemies before it finally explodes.

entries.title: Schofield Pistol
entries.summary: A dependable revolver and the first firearm you find in the campaign.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Samâ€™s old-fashioned sidearm. You can find a pistol in the Upper Temple of Herkat.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Press 2 to select it. Enable Enhanced weapons in Extras for the optional Colts. Once youâ€™ve got both, press 2 again to switch between one and two.

entries.title: Thompson Sub Machine Gun
entries.summary: An automatic weapon for keeping groups of enemies under fire.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: The Thompson works well against enemies at short and medium range.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Hold fire to keep shooting while youâ€™ve got ammo. Let go to stop.

entries.title: Time Strike
entries.summary: Drops a heavy object onto an enemyâ€™s position.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Scientists send heavy objects back through time to the spot Sam aims at.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Aim at a living enemy. A successful shot marks its position, so a moving enemy can get away. An attempt with no valid target uses no ammo; tougher enemies may survive a hit.

entries.title: Uni-Directional Microwave Transmitter
entries.summary: A heavy blast weapon with a bright flash and a pause between attacks.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: A communications device turned into a weapon that heats its targets. Look for U.M.T. on the map.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Deals heavy damage to regular enemies it can target. It doesnâ€™t hurt players or either boss.

entries.title: Aludran Arachnoid
entries.summary: A scorpion-like enemy that opens fire from a distance.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: An armed, many-legged hybrid that likes to fire from a distance.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Watch for incoming shots before moving closer. Contact with it also hurts.

entries.title: Aludran Reptiloid
entries.summary: A tough enemy that often attacks from far away.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Its acid missiles come quickly, and it takes a fair bit of punishment. Heavy weapons help.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Bring a heavy weapon and keep an eye on higher ledges. It can aim down at Sam from above.

entries.title: Beheaded Kamikaze
entries.summary: Runs straight at you with bombs in hand.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: A reanimated attacker carrying bombs. Its scream usually gives it away before it reaches you.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Listen for its scream and keep your distance. It explodes when it gets close enough, hurting anyone nearby.

entries.title: Bladder Beast
entries.summary: A swollen Methug relative that attacks with spit.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Its inflatable body sacs help it move around. Watch out for the corrosive spit.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Avoid its shots and keep clear of its body, which can also hurt Sam.

entries.title: Cyclops
entries.summary: A fast-moving, one-eyed enemy with club-like arms.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Donâ€™t let its speed catch you out. It closes the gap quickly.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: It can shoot as well as hurt Sam up close. Keep moving and watch the distance between you.

entries.title: Gunrilla
entries.summary: A heavily armed gorilla mutant with a cannon built into its body.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Slow-moving, but dangerous both up close and at a distance.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Dodge its cannonballs and avoid its strong close-range attack.

entries.title: Hermit Crabuloid
entries.summary: A shelled enemy that hides, emerges and attacks.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: The shell protects it while it hides. Watch for the body to come back out.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Watch for it to come out of hiding. It can jump as it gets close.

entries.title: Methug Commander
entries.summary: A small hovering Methug with a dangerous touch.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: You can tell it apart from the soldier by its eye and hanging body.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Keep it at a distance. It attacks on contact; despite the original guideâ€™s description, it doesnâ€™t fire an eye bolt in the game.

entries.title: Methug Soldier
entries.summary: A floating soldier that fires bolts and hurts Sam on contact.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: One of the first enemies youâ€™ll meet. It floats along with its legs trailing behind it.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Watch for its shots and avoid letting it float into you.

entries.title: Sirian Sphinx
entries.summary: The boss waiting at the end of the Egyptian chapter.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: The Sphinx has its own health bar and battle music. Be ready for the enemies it summons.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Fight it in the sixth campaign level. It alternates between firing volleys and calling in reinforcements.

entries.title: Sirian Werebull
entries.summary: A charging beast that can knock Sam back.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: Sidestep the charge, then attack while it turns around for another go.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Dodge the charge, then use the time it takes to turn around to attack.

entries.title: Wolfiator
entries.summary: The armoured boss at the end of the Roman chapter.

sections.title: About it
sections.text: A towering wolf in a plumed helmet, with minions to back it up.

sections.title: Playing tips
sections.text: Fight it in Caesarâ€™s Palace, the final campaign level. Expect five-shot volleys and waves of reinforcements. The full campaign is still being playtested.

entries.title: Ammunition
entries.summary: Keep your weapons supplied.

sections.title: How they work
sections.text: Look for bullets, shells, rockets, cannonballs and coloured energy cells. You can collect ammo before finding its weapon, as long as you have room for more.

sections.title: Names on the map
sections.text: Cannon balls, Minigun ammo, Prion red cell, Rockets, Shotgun cartridges, Timestrike blue cell, Tommygun ammo.

entries.title: Ankhs and special pickups
entries.summary: Some pickups also make something happen in the level.

sections.title: How they work
sections.text: Touching certain pickups can start an event, even when you cannot collect the item itself. Select one on the map to see what it does.

sections.title: Names on the map
sections.text: Level exit / ankh trigger.

entries.title: Armor and shields
entries.summary: Help Sam take more hits.

sections.title: How they work
sections.text: Armor and shields come in 25-, 50- and 100-point sizes. You can collect them while the matching protection value is below 100.

sections.title: Names on the map
sections.text: 100 armor, 25 armor, 50 armor.

entries.title: Backpacks and power-ups
entries.summary: Extra supplies and temporary help.

sections.title: How they work
sections.text: Look for backpacks and Serious power among the map’s other items. Use the map filters to find them separately from health, armor and ammo.

sections.title: Names on the map
sections.text: Backpack, Serious power.

entries.title: Health pickups
entries.summary: Restore Sam’s health.

sections.title: How they work
sections.text: Health pickups add 25, 50 or 100 points. You can collect the smaller ones when health is below 100. The +100 pickup works below 200 and adds the full amount: 199 becomes 299.

sections.title: Names on the map
sections.text: 100 health (collect below 200), 25 health, 50 health.

entries.title: Doors, switches and encounters
entries.summary: The map can change as you move through it.

sections.title: Doors and enemy waves
sections.text: Using a switch or entering an area can open a door, move a lift or bring in more enemies. Sometimes you need to defeat a group before you can move on.

sections.title: Reading the map
sections.text: Select a door, switch or green event area to see what happens there. In 3D, Show doors open lets you look through doorways. The viewer does not run the level’s events.

entries.title: Finding secrets
entries.summary: Look around every map and discover some of its hidden places.

sections.title: Secrets marked so far
sections.text: Five secrets are marked across the first five campaign levels, with links to walkthroughs. The list is still growing, so an unmarked map may have secrets too.

sections.title: Using the maps
sections.text: Use the 3D map to find items and enemies, look around rooms and see their heights. Hide ceilings for a clearer view from above.

entries.title: Progress and passwords
entries.summary: Pick up your campaign progress from the main menu.

sections.title: Campaign progress
sections.text: Beating a level unlocks the next one in Select Level. Keep save.dat when updating to keep your unlocks. All twelve campaign levels are available, including Caesar’s Palace. There are no mid-level saves.

sections.title: Using a password
sections.text: Enter an original game password to start with that level’s weapons, ammo and difficulty. Uppercase and lowercase both work. Select Level also gives you the original starting supplies.

entries.title: Sam on PC
entries.summary: Play with a keyboard and mouse, plus optional jumping and third-person view.

sections.title: Moving around
sections.text: WASD moves and the mouse looks. Enable Jump in Extras to use Space; H switches between first- and third-person views when enabled. Jump and the third-person toggle are PC additions. The camera moves closer when walls get in the way.

sections.title: Fighting and using things
sections.text: Left-click fires. E uses doors and switches. Number keys 1–0 and the mouse wheel select weapons; Q goes back to the last weapon. R reloads Colts with Enhanced weapons enabled. Enable Automap in Extras to use M, and zoom with +/minus or the mouse wheel. F11 toggles fullscreen/windowed mode. Esc/P pauses or resumes. Tab/N opens the in-game NETRICSA guide when enabled.

entries.title: Weapons and supplies
entries.summary: What you carry, and what changes when you start a level.

sections.title: Starting a level
sections.text: Select Level and passwords give you the original starting weapons and ammo for that level. Finishing the previous level carries your supplies and score forward. Restarting puts you back with what you had when you entered.

sections.title: Picking things up
sections.text: Walk over pickups to collect them. Ammo only needs space to carry more; a matching weapon is not required. Already-owned weapons can supply ammo. Health, armor and shields have their own limits.
